title: checkpoint.list
description: Lists the checkpoints of the agent run in a pane, newest first, read from its store on demand and never kept by the core (ADR-0050). Metadata only, never a path. Who may call is as for checkpoint.take, with no rate limit. Needs hello version 2.

pane.description: The pane of the run, the agent's pane that agent.launch opened.

time.description: When it was taken, Unix seconds.

more.description: The oldest checkpoints left out to keep the answer within 4 KiB.
